reptant.definition:
a. Same as Repent.
a. Creeping; crawling; -- said of reptiles, worms, etc.

reptantia.definition: n. pl. A division of gastropods; the Pectinibranchiata.

reptations.definition:
plural of reptation
n. The act of creeping.

reptilarium.translation: n. 爬行动物馆, 蛇馆

reptile.definition: n. any cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia including tortoises, turtles, snakes, lizards, alligators, crocodiles, and extinct forms
reptile.translation:
n. 爬行动物, 爬虫, 卑鄙的人
a. 爬行的, 爬虫类的, 卑鄙的

reptile-like.translation: a. 爬虫类的；卑鄙的 (reptile的变形)

reptiles.definition: n any cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia including tortoises, turtles, snakes, lizards, alligators, crocodiles, and extinct forms
reptiles.translation: n. 爬行类；爬虫类；爬行动物（reptile的复数）

reptilia.definition: n class of cold-blooded air-breathing vertebrates with completely ossified skeleton and a body usually covered with scales or horny plates; once the dominant land animals
reptilia.translation: n. [动] 爬虫类, 爬行动物

reptilian.definition: a. of or relating to the class Reptilia
reptilian.translation:
a. 爬虫类的, 像爬虫的, 卑鄙的
n. 爬行动物

reptilians.definition:
plural of reptilian
a. of or relating to the class Reptilia
reptilians.translation:
(reptilian 的复数) a. 爬虫类的, 像爬虫的, 卑鄙的
n. 爬行动物

reptiliary.translation: n. 爬行动物馆, 蛇馆
